intro: A single checkpoint tracks all 40 complete LAFAN1 sequences. Compare success, completion and tracking accuracy under a shared robot and protocol.

sections.title: 01 · Dataset
paragraphs: LAFAN40 uses all 40 G1 sequences from the LAFAN1 Retargeting Dataset. Motions are used as supplied, without filtering by difficulty.

rows: 40 clips · 8,822.1667 seconds · first frame to exact final timestamp
The manifest fixes filenames, file sizes and SHA256 checksums.

notes: This measures tracking on the supplied reference set; it does not establish that every motion is physically feasible or unseen during training.
